summary: Ridgetech Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $184,720,213 of ordinary shares under a new sales agreement with Pacific Century Securities LLC, replacing a prior ATM program terminated July 11, 2026. The shares are sold at market prices on NASDAQ (closing price $1.23 on July 27, 2026) with a 3.5% commission to the agent. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
